message.content:
According to the data provided in the tables, Li Hua requests a delivery from Hailey Johnson on two separate occasions. The first delivery request is for bread and milk to be sent to Li Hua's place on a weekly basis, specifically on Mondays and Fridays at 8am. This conversation is detailed in the first content source:

```
id,content
0,"Time: 20260318_15:00
LiHua: Hey Hailey! Your bread and milk are seriously amazing! 😋 Do you think you could send me some bread twice a week, like Mondays at 8am and Fridays at 8am? That would be awesome!
HaileyJohnson: Thanks so much for the love! 💖 I’ll definitely set you up for Monday and Friday deliveries at 8am. Fresh bread and milk will be waiting for you! 🥖🥛 Can’t wait!
LiHua: Awesome! Thanks, Hailey! Looking forward to it! 😄
HaileyJohnson: You’re welcome! If you ever want to try something special or have any requests, just let me know. Enjoy! 🍞✨
LiHua: Will do! You're the best! Enjoy your day! 😊
HaileyJohnson: Thanks! You too, Li Hua! 🎉👩‍🍳"
```

In the second delivery request scenario, Li Hua expresses interest in HaileyJohnson's special offer for holiday discounts and hints at the possibility of ordering for the occasion. This interaction is shown in the second content source:

```
1,"Time: 20260816_20:00
HaileyJohnson: Hey Li Hua! 🎉 I’m excited to announce a special sale for the upcoming holiday at the bakery! 🌟 As one of my favorite regulars, I’d love to offer you an early bird discount. Let me know if you’re interested! 🥐💖
LiHua: Wow, that's awesome! I'm definitely interested! What kind of specials do you have in mind? 🍞🎉
HaileyJohnson: Yay! I'm glad to hear that! 🎊 We're planning on some festive breads and pastries, plus personalized cakes for special occasions. I can give you 15% off your order if you order by the end of this week! ✨ What do you think?
LiHua: That sounds amazing! I'll have to get a few things for the holiday. Thanks for the discount! Can't wait to try your goodies! 😊🍰
HaileyJohnson: You're welcome! I'm sure you'll love everything! If you have any specific requests or flavors in mind, just let me know. 🥳 I’ll make it extra special for you!
LiHua: Will do! I’ll think about it and message you soon. Thanks again! 🥐💖"
```

These instances reflect Li Hua's interest in receiving regular and special deliveries from Hailey Johnson's bakery. The requests for delivery are scheduled for Mondays and Fridays at 8am, particularly with a focus on holiday arrangements.
